page.description: What Yog-Scope observes, protocol by protocol: TVL, volume, fees, active pools, most traded tokens and signals, over the chosen period.

unavailable.label: Why "—"?
unavailable.previous: The previous period starts before {since}, the first hour measured: no comparison with an incomplete sum.
unavailable.tvlStart: The TVL has no measure at the start of the period: its change cannot be computed.
unavailable.tvlDiscovered: The share of the pools discovered during the period is not measured: without it, the change would count a discovery as a deposit.

info.tvl: The value deposited in the pools Yog-Scope has observed since 1 October 2026, at the end of the last complete hour: their reserves, each at its token's Jupiter price when under 15 minutes old. A token without a price counts as 0. The TVL says what is deposited, not what can be traded. Its change compares with its level at the start of the chosen period, without the pools discovered during the period: a pool seen for the first time brings its whole stock, which is not a deposit.
info.volume: What was traded over the chosen period, valued at each trade's own price, up to the last complete hour. The change compares with the previous period of the same length.
info.fees: What those trades paid in fees over the chosen period: the depositors' (LP) share and the protocol's.
info.swaps: The number of trades over the chosen period, and their average pace per second.
info.pools: The pools with at least one trade over the chosen period, among every pool Yog-Scope has seen, and those born during the period.
info.rotation: The chosen period's volume divided by the TVL: how many times the deposited liquidity changed hands.

page.description: Meteora's DAMM v2 protocol: TVL, volume, fees and active pools, over the chosen period.
page.title: DAMM v2

info.fees: What this protocol's trades paid in fees over the chosen period: the depositors' (LP) share and the protocol's. The effective rate relates these fees to the volume.

liquidity.title: How liquidity moves
liquidity.info: The curve is the TVL hour by hour. Under it, above the axis, the liquidity deposited when pools are created then added; below it, the liquidity removed. Each move is valued at its pool's price, never above what the pool traded; a token without a market price counts 0, as in the TVL.
liquidity.notMeasured: Liquidity has been measured only recently: the chosen period starts before, and a total would undercount it.
liquidity.noCurve: Not enough measured hours of TVL to draw the curve yet.
liquidity.curveLabel: TVL over the period, from {low} to {high}
liquidity.tvlNow: Now: {tvl} · hover or touch the curve for detail
liquidity.flowsHourly: Created, added and removed per hour
liquidity.flowsDaily: Created, added and removed per day
liquidity.flowsLabel: Liquidity created, added and removed over the chosen period

moves.title: Largest LP moves · {period}
moves.info: The largest liquidity creations, deposits and withdrawals of the period, valued at their pool's price. The address is their owner's.
moves.tableLabel: Largest LP moves over the chosen period
moves.empty: No valued move over the period.

volume.title: Where the volume comes from
volume.info: A rotation run: 5-minute stretches in which a pool's SOL, USDC or USDT side (its smaller side if it has none or two) changes hands at least once, no more than 30 minutes apart; the run lasts from the first to the last. The volume shown stays the real volume; the run says where it comes from.
volume.notMeasured: Rotation runs are not measured yet.
volume.chartLabelHourly: Volume per hour, in runs and outside them
volume.chartLabelDaily: Volume per day, in runs and outside them

stats.title: Rotation runs · {period}
stats.info: The runs that started in the period: how many, on how many pools, how many still go on, how long they last from start to end (so far for those in progress), and the share of their volume traded in their first hour.

runs.title: Largest runs · {period}
runs.info: The runs of largest volume that started in the period, with their start in UTC and their length. A run in progress may still grow; an ended one has had no tranche in a run for 30 minutes.
runs.tableLabel: Largest rotation runs in the chosen period

page.description: Live feed of the detectors' conclusions: flow imbalances, price deviations — every anomaly worth a look, as it is detected.

feed.title: Latest signals
feed.empty: No signal yet — the detectors are watching.

price_oracle_deviation.summary: The pool's price is {deviation} away from the oracle price.
price_oracle_deviation.explain: Compares the pool's spot price (derived from its on-chain state) with the two tokens' oracle price (Jupiter). A relative gap beyond the threshold flags a price detached from the market — possible arbitrage or abnormal liquidity. The threshold shown on each signal is the one that was crossed (warning or critical).

flow_imbalance.summary: Swap volume leans {percent} in one direction.
flow_imbalance.explain: Measures the directional imbalance of swap volume over a rolling window: (A→B volume − B→A volume) / total volume, from −100% to +100%. A flow leaning hard one way flags sustained buy or sell pressure. A volume floor filters out near-idle pools.

tvl_drain.summary: {percent} of the pool's liquidity has left.
tvl_drain.explain: Measures, over a rolling window, the share of the pool's starting TVL that has been withdrawn: (removals − adds) / starting TVL. A high drain flags an LP exodus or rug-like behaviour. Withdrawals offset by deposits (rebalancing) cancel out; a TVL floor filters out dust pools, and a pool whose tokens cannot be priced is skipped rather than misread.
